text:
maria: Heads up — deploybot blocked image publish for staging (change window) due to provenance attestation mismatch in eu-west-1. Canaries already started.

deploy-bot: publish blocked: provenance-check FAILED for image sha256:abcd1234... in eu-west-1 -> status: HOLD

aj: What specifically mismatched? digest vs attestation timestamp or signer? Any log snippet?

maria: cosign verify shows attestation timestamp older than manifest. example: `cosign verify --key $KMS_URI eu-west-1/myrepo@sha256:abcd1234...` returns timestamp 2026-03-20T22:10:00Z vs manifest 2026-03-21T00:05:00Z

sophie: Looks like the regional mirror pulled an older attestation blob. Mirror TTL + out-of-order replication. We should pin the canary to the digest and continue baseline traffic.

tarun: Agreed. Proposal: 1) pin canary route to sha256:abcd1234... 2) revert staging 'latest' tag to prev digest sha256:12345678... 3) manual cosign re-sign in eu-west-1 mirror. Any objections?

aj: :thumbsup: I'll pin canary in the routing layer. Tag revert needs release team approval (simon).

maria: @simon release team — confirm revert in the 30m change window? We have 20m until the window starts.

simon: Ok revert approved for emergency fix. I'll notify infra on-call and update release notes.

devops-oncall: I'm on it. I'll scrub attestations and coordinate cosign re-sign. ETA ~15m.

sophie: Note — manual re-sign must use KMS key rotation v2. Command I'll run: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/…/keys/release-v2 --attestation=att.json eu-west-1/myrepo@sha256:abcd1234...`

aj: Pinned canary route: router-api set image_digest=sha256:abcd1234... -> done. Canary traffic at 3%.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary publish still blocked for staging tag 'latest' due to provenance mismatch. manual promote disabled.

maria: After re-sign, flush ECR regional cache so mirror picks up the new attestation. Suggested commands: `aws ecr batch-check-layer-availability` && invoke lambda invalidate.

devops-oncall: Flushing cache now. Re-signed attestation pushed and visible in eu-west-1. Confirmed via `cosign verify`.

simon: Manual promote ready pending final validation. Approve to revert 'latest' and then promote sha256:abcd1234... ?

aj: Reverted staging 'latest' to sha256:12345678... and queued manual promote to sha256:abcd1234... once attestations fully propagate.

sophie: Updating release notes: "hotfix: staging publish held due to provenance attestation mismatch in eu-west-1; canary pinned to digest; manual promote scheduled after re-attestation."

maria: Follow-ups: 1) add attestation vs manifest timestamp check in mirror pipeline 2) add alert for digest-attestation-skew 3) postmortem if this recurs.

devops-oncall: Filed INF-5892: mirror attestation timestamp check + alerting. Assigned to eng-infra.

simon: Thanks all. Stand down unless canary shows degradation.

[end thread]
